events.description: Multiple players from opposing teams (white pinstripe jerseys vs. blue jerseys) are engaged in a physical altercation near the basket, with hands grabbing, pushing, and pulling; one player in blue (Fisher #2) is on the ground while others surround and grapple him.

A player in a blue jersey (Fisher #2) is on the floor, seemingly helpless, while multiple opponents in white pinstripe jerseys lean over and appear to strike or press down on him; this constitutes attacking a helpless victim.

A second phase of the altercation occurs further from the basket, involving players including O'Neal (#34), Fisher (#2), and Anderson (#40), with visible shoving, grabbing, and attempts to separate by officials and coaches; active mutual combat continues.

A player in a white pinstripe jersey is on the floor near the baseline, surrounded by multiple opponents and staff; one opponent appears to be pressing down or striking while the victim is down and unable to defend himself.

A physical altercation erupts on the court involving multiple players, referees, and coaches; players in blue (Lakers) and white/red (Magic) jerseys are seen grappling, with referee #50 and a suited man intervening to separate them.

After the initial scuffle, a player in a white/red uniform (No. 40, Anderson) is on the ground while others stand over or kneel near him; one individual in a light shirt appears to be striking or pressing down on the prone player, consistent with attacking a helpless victim.

A physical altercation erupts on the court involving multiple players and staff; players in purple (Lakers) and white pinstriped (Magic) jerseys are seen grappling, pushing, and surrounding a player on the ground while coaches and officials intervene to separate them.

A player in a white pinstriped jersey (No. 40, Anderson) is seen standing over and appearing to strike or kick a downed opponent lying on the floor, while others attempt to restrain him — consistent with attacking a helpless victim.

After the initial melee subsides, a separate confrontation occurs near the free-throw line: a Magic player (No. 0, Anderson) and a referee (No. 26) engage in a physical struggle, with the player grabbing the referee’s arm/shoulder and the referee attempting to control him; another Magic player (No. 1) observes nearby.

Two players engage in mutual physical combat: a Lakers player (No. 20, Shaq) and a Rockets player (No. 41, Hakeem Olajuwon) grapple, push, and wrestle for position near the basket, with visible arm-wrestling, chest-to-chest contact, and aggressive posturing; this is not incidental contact but sustained, intentional physical struggle.

Multiple players from opposing teams (Lakers in purple and Hornets in white) are engaged in a physical altercation, with visible grappling, pushing, and attempts to separate them by teammates and officials.
During the scuffle, a player in a white jersey appears to strike or shove a player in a purple jersey who is on the ground or off-balance, constituting an attack on a temporarily helpless individual.
